rootCause: The README only documents the end-user path (`npx readme-md-generator` which fetches from npm) but omits the `npm install` step required to run the CLI from a local clone; on a clean machine the local binary entry point (`readme` → `src/cli.js`) fails with "readme: not found" because dependencies are missing and npx cannot resolve the local bin script.
patch:
--- README.md
+++ README.md
@@ -49,6 +49,16 @@
 
 ## 🚀 Usage
 
 Make sure you have [npx](https://www.npmjs.com/package/npx) installed (`npx` is shipped by default since npm `5.2.0`)
 
 Just run the following command at the root of your project and answer questions:
 
 ```sh
 npx readme-md-generator
 ```
 
+## 🛠 Development
+
+To run from a local clone (for development or testing):
+
+```sh
+git clone https://github.com/kefranabg/readme-md-generator
+cd readme-md-generator
+npm install
+node src/cli.js --version
+```
+
 Or use default values for all questions (`-y`):
 
 ```sh
 npx readme-md-generator -y
 ```
